title: SketchUp workflows and connector status
description: Explore SketchUp workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

SketchUp

SketchUp supports direct 3D modelling for rapid architectural massing, spatial studies and design communication.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Shape the courtyard massing

Develop the two-storey courtyard massing from the original Vector OS building study and keep the canopy legible in context.

Organise building elements with tags

Organise walls, roofs, openings and the canopy as named groups with a proposed tag structure for human review.

Prepare scenes and a concept drawing

Prepare concept scenes plus plan and section companions from the same building subject; no native SketchUp capture is implied.

View the original concept
